title: Leveraging generative hallucination and biophysics-informed modeling for unified biomolecular sequence-structure co-design
abstract: arXiv:2608.17381v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Biomolecular design underpins applications from molecular recognition to therapeutics and synthetic biology, yet de novo interaction design remains challenging-especially for DNA/RNA, underexplored non-protein modalities with scarce, heterogeneous complex data and sharper geometric and chemical constraints. We introduce MCTH (Monte Carlo Tree Hallucination), an inference-only framework that casts all-atom sequence-structure co-design as uncertainty-aware planning over hallucinated states from pretrained folding and inverse-folding models, with optional biophysical control within the same decision loop. MCTH treats these models as frozen black-box operators and uses Monte Carlo Tree Search to allocate a fixed inference budget across competing design trajectories, incorporating model confidence and uncertainty, as well as cross-expert consensus/disagreement when multiple predictors are available. translated_title: 利用生成性幻觉与生物物理信息建模实现统一生物分子序列-结构协同设计
translated_abstract: 生物分子设计支撑着从分子识别到治疗和合成生物学等应用，但从头相互作用设计仍然具有挑战性——尤其是对于DNA/RNA，这些未被充分探索的非蛋白质模态，其复合物数据稀缺且异质，并具有更严格的几何和化学约束。我们提出了MCTH（蒙特卡洛树幻觉），一个仅基于推理的框架，将全原子序列-结构协同设计视为对来自预训练折叠和逆折叠模型的幻觉状态的不确定性感知规划，并在同一决策循环中可选的生物物理控制。MCTH将这些模型视为冻结的黑盒操作符，并使用蒙特卡洛树搜索在竞争性设计轨迹中分配固定的推理预算，结合模型置信度和不确定性，以及在多个预测器可用时的跨专家共识/分歧。在蛋白质-RNA、蛋白质-DNA、蛋白质-蛋白质等设计任务中，MCTH展示了其通用性和有效性。
tldr: MCTH通过蒙特卡洛树搜索和生成性幻觉，统一了生物分子序列与结构的协同设计，在蛋白质-RNA/DNA等复杂模态上实现了高效的推理式设计，并集成了生物物理控制。
en_tdlr: MCTH unifies biomolecular sequence-structure co-design via Monte Carlo tree search and generative hallucination, enabling efficient inference-only design for complex modalities like protein-RNA/DNA with integrated biophysical control.
